name: team_standup
description: Team cycle (roadmap Phase 2, §4.3 standup): the Lead folds the tracking board, computes dependency-ready work, sizes this wave from it (team_board.size_wave formula, throttled by the budget state), gates dispatch on shared-file ownership (H1), and dispatches implementer code_subtask forks with the live board rollup + teammates' lessons + the item's directives injected into each prompt.

repoPath.description: The shared run worktree; each fork's worktree is created under it, rooted at the shared branch head.

contractPaths.description: Frozen-contract paths injected into each prompt.

maxWidth.description: Max concurrent implementers this wave (the team-size ceiling).

budgetState.description: Last budget gate state (ok/warn/halt) — throttles team size.

dynamicTasks.description: FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC descriptors, one code_subtask per dispatched item.

dynamicTasksInput.description: Per-fork input map keyed by item id.

dispatched.description: Items dispatched this wave [{id, description, files, attempt}].

waveBase.description: Shared branch head at standup — the base each item's peer-review diff is taken from.

teamSize.description: Wave size the sizing formula chose.

drainedBefore.description: True when the board had no open items before this wave (nothing left to do).
